svg.title: Capabilities
svg.desc: LLM apps & agents: Claude, Gemini, Ollama, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, FAISS · pgvector, Evals, Prompt engineering (proof: HireLens · ForecastGPT · REFLEX-AI · SearchScribe AI); Backend & APIs: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, Hono, SQLAlchemy, OpenAPI, JWT, REST · SSE (proof: SearchScribe AI · ForecastGPT · HireLens · day job); Data & storage: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Firebase, Drizzle ORM, Neon, Redis/RQ jobs (proof: HireLens · ForecastGPT · yDirect · day job); Frontend & extensions: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Vite, Chrome, Manifest V3 (proof: HireLens · yDirect · WriteRight · abhayemekar.me); ML & analytics: TensorFlow, OpenCV, pandas, NumPy, Jupyter, Power BI · DAX (proof: 3-Factor Login · CricketStat Pro); Ship & operate: Docker, Actions, Vercel, Render, Sentry, Pytest, npm, Git, Playwright (proof: HireLens · SearchScribe AI · this profile)
